verdict: Leads surging this week; cost per lead rising with spend — being managed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 95 leads from Meta at a $5.23 cost per lead, with the past 7 days showing a sharp acceleration — leads more than doubled week-over-week as spend scaled up significantly. The efficiency signal to watch is that spend grew faster than leads, pushing cost per lead up 16.45% week-over-week; that trend is being addressed by monitoring campaign pacing closely before scaling further. Google Business Profile engagement dropped 54.55% week-over-week and will be a focus alongside the paid push. Website conversion tracking is being repaired, so the pipeline confirmation number currently under-reports what is actually arriving. Several planned buildouts — including landing pages, search campaigns, and nurture sequences — are in progress and their completion next period will give you fuller attribution and additional lead sources.
